headline: Approved prior meeting minutes and kept changes to the agenda decision-making framework; discussed street light LED upgrades with no other votes.
summary: The meeting covered a street light LED upgrade, commissioner terms, and a composting proposal from another commission. Members approved the previous meeting minutes and kept changes to the agenda decision-making framework.
decisions: Kept the changes made to the working framework for building and maintaining the agenda.
